description: FROZEN identity of the ONE approved ADR-0043 validation-box deploy object. The hardened provisioner reads every identity from here — bucket, key, S3 object VersionId, sha256, byte size, and the two provenance commits. Runtime environment values are permitted ONLY as assertions that must equal these exactly; the provisioner refuses (before contacting S3) on any mismatch. Changing the approved object requires editing this committed manifest under review. This revision advances the deploy to 38f40b4, the squash merge of PR #535 (owner re-review GO at exact head 1ac3ec9): the governed account-3 loss-control bootstrap tool (first-provisioning-only, atomic row+audit transaction via the new transaction-owned LossControlService.bootstrap_state_row, authorship-checked against ON CONFLICT no-ops) plus the blocking preflight corrections from Phase-0 attempt 1 (2026-07-28) — the churn driver preflight and the session-open readiness package now refuse/report an absent, non-NORMAL, or invalid-version risk_loss_control_state row by name (LOSS_CONTROL_STATE_MISSING / _NOT_NORMAL / _VERSION_INVALID), aligning readiness with the ENFORCE order gate's fail-closed behavior. THE ADR-0043 IMPLEMENTATION BASELINE ADVANCES to the #535 squash commit 38f40b46906fc91497049924f7a62e7384d67653 — that advance IS the substance of this review: #535 changes the governed path apps/backend/scripts/adr0043_churn_driver.py, so build-deploy-archive.sh refuses (exit 3) against the previous baseline 1773707700abaac981a44f6ed25b740909f5646f (#498). With deployed == implementation == 38f40b4 the governed-path delta is EMPTY and governed_paths_match is true; present_in_deploy_delta and excluded_from_deploy are both empty. Archive built LF-clean (core.autocrlf=false, core.eol=lf) and verified byte-identical to the merged git tree via batched git hash-object --no-filters for 1854/1854 files, ZERO exceptions (archive population: 1854 deployment-source files + 1 generated DEPLOYED_BUILD_INFO.json marker = 1855); S3's own SHA-256 checksum decodes to the recorded sha256 and an independent versioned readback matched it. CAVEAT carried forward from the prior revision: the operator tools adr0043_reachability.py / adr0043_scoped_sync.py / adr0043_session_open.py and the new adr0043_bootstrap_loss_control.py are NOT members of the builder's GOVERNED_PATHS set (follow-up #532); for this deploy their byte identity is verified manually against the merged blobs (the empty-delta build makes every deployed file baseline-pinned regardless).
